Ekstra kort, Robotter og 3D-printer får samme breddebeskyttelse og responsive resize-signal.
Kortbyggeren prioriterer nu relevante og tilgængelige Home Assistant-entities efter korttype, område og view, mens søgning stadig dækker alle entities.
Alle kortlayouts får en lokal historik med de seneste otte gemninger og kan gendannes direkte fra redigeringslinjen.
Store kamera-, graf- og kontrolkort kan nu ændres op til tolv rækker og får altid scrollplads under sig, så resize-håndtaget ikke klippes af.
Sideadministrationen tager sikkerhedskopi af navigationen før ændringer og kræver bekræftelse før en side fjernes.
Touchstyring i genbrugelige funktionskort viser nu tydeligt, når en kommando sendes, lykkes eller fejler, og beskytter mod dobbelte tryk.
Kilde og live-kopi bruger nye cacheversioner, så kioskbrowseren henter editorforbedringerne uden at genbruge gamle filer.
Kortgalleriet indeholder nu komplette funktionsskabeloner til termostater, sikkerhed, rum, medieafspillere, pool, bil, robotter, vejr og 3D-printere.
Skabelonerne har egne professionelle renderere med relevante nøgletal og touchstyring i stedet for den tidligere generiske tabelvisning.
Galleriet viser kategori, antal entityfelter og krævede felter, mens kortindstillinger markerer manglende obligatoriske entities tydeligt.
Hvert ekstrakort kan nu flyttes, ændres i størrelse, omdøbes, skjules, duplikeres, nulstilles eller slettes direkte i editoren.
Gemte ekstrakort renderes nu straks efter en genindlæsning, og ældre enkelt-entity-kort migreres automatisk til skabelonens nye bindingsstruktur.
Kameraer beholder kvalitetsvalg, grafer bruger HA-historik, og styringskort sender de korrekte Home Assistant-services.
Varme, Pool, Bil, Vejr, Musik, Kalender, Kameraer og Rum bruger nu samme direkte layouteditor som de øvrige professionelle views.
Indbyggede områder kan flyttes, ændres i størrelse, omdøbes og skjules med touchvenlige håndtag samt fælles Gem og Annullér.
Den samme tre-prik-knap giver adgang til både indbyggede områder og ekstra kort fra den fælles kortbygger uden dobbelte redigeringsknapper.
Hvert view har fået et skærmtilpasset 12-kolonne standardlayout, der kan vokse nedad med scrolling i stedet for at klippe kort af.
Styringsknapper, kameraer og medieelementer modtager ikke tryk under layoutredigering, så touch-flytning er sikker.
Serverkonfigurationen gemmes nu i en kø og med låst, eksplicit filafkortning, så hurtige layoutgemninger ikke kan beskadige config.json på monterede appdata-drev.
Sikkerhedskortene kan nu flyttes og ændres i størrelse direkte på siden med touchvenlige håndtag og fælles Gem/Annullér-linje.
Navn, synlighed, bredde, højde samt alarm-, låse- og åbningsentities kan redigeres for hvert af de tre indbyggede sikkerhedskort.
Alarm- og låseknapper er deaktiveret under layoutredigering, så flytning ikke kan sende utilsigtede kommandoer.
Kortgalleriet har fået skabeloner til samlet sikkerhedsstatus, alarmsystemer og kombinerede indgange/låse.
Den dobbelte åbningsmåling i sikkerhedsstatus er erstattet af en særskilt tæller for åbne døre og vinduer.
Sikkerhed-viewet er migreret til en native kortmodel med særskilte kort for samlet status, alarmsystemer og indgange/åbninger.
Eksisterende serverkonfiguration migreres automatisk og kan fremover overskrives med kortspecifikke alarm-, låse- og åbningsentities.
Standardlayoutet udnytter nu hele skærmen uden overlap: samlet status til venstre og systemer samt indgange i højre side.
Det tidligere dobbelte redigeringspunkt er fjernet, mens den næste del af den direkte sikkerhedsredigering bygges på den nye model.
Energi-layoutet bruger nu faste gemte koordinater, så nøgletal, energiassistent og begge grafer står korrekt uden tomme områder eller overlap.
Flytning bytter kortenes placering, mens touch-resize gemmer bredde og højde og kan annulleres øjeblikkeligt i både Overblik og Nu.
Indstillingsdialogen anvender ændringer straks, også i den optimerede Nu-visning, og gem/reload er verificeret.
Kortgalleriet indeholder nu komplette energiskabeloner til prisgraf, forbrugsgraf, energiassistent, Nu-overblik og enhedsforbrug med egne HA-bindings.
Genbrugelige pris- og forbrugsgrafer har fået dedikerede renderere med prisbjælker, nøgletal og rigtig Home Assistant-historik.
Energi-viewet har nu en fælles native kortmodel for nøgletal, energiassistent, prisgraf, forbrugsgraf, Nu-overblik og enhedsforbrug.
Eksisterende energikort kan flyttes og ændres i størrelse direkte på siden med touchvenlige greb og fælles gem/annullér-linje.
Navn, rækkefølge, synlighed, størrelse og relevante Home Assistant-entities kan konfigureres pr. energikort med fallback til serverens standardopsætning.
Den ene tre-prik-menu samler redigering af native energikort og tilføjelse af ekstra kort fra skabelongalleriet.
Både Overblik og Nu bevarer live-opdateringer og deres aktive visning under det nye layoutsystem.
Kortbyggeren understøtter nu skabeloner med flere navngivne HA-enheder, så komplette energi-, varme-, sikkerheds-, pool-, bil- og printerkort kan konfigureres samlet.
Grafkort henter nu rigtig 24-timers historik fra Home Assistant i stedet for eksempeldata og genbruger data i en kort cache.
Touch-knapper kan nu vælge konkret service, kræve bekræftelse og vise en sikker optaget-tilstand mens kommandoen sendes.
Kort kan vises betinget ud fra en valgfri HA-entity og state, men forbliver synlige i redigeringstilstand.
Live-opdateringer sættes nu sikkert i kø under hele redigeringstilstanden, så kortbyggeren ikke forsvinder midt i flytning eller resize.
Kvalitetsmenuen viser nu kun de to reelle go2rtc-livekilder: Høj hovedstream og Lav substream.
Tidligere medium-indstillinger migreres automatisk til Lav, da begge pegede på samme substream.
Det aktive streamvalg markeres tydeligt, og kvalitetsskift genopretter afspilleren med det nye streamnavn.
Forsiden og kamerasiden bruger nu den samme fælles kamerakomponent med navn, bevægelse og kvalitetsmenu.
Kvalitetsskift ændrer nu den reelle go2rtc-livekilde mellem hovedstream og substream.
Hvert kamera på forsiden har en tre-prik-menu, og den gemte startkvalitet anvendes på tværs af dashboardet.
Kameravælgeren på forsiden viser fortsat ét fysisk kamera ad gangen uden dublerede kvalitetsentities.
Sider kan nu flyttes direkte med et stort touchvenligt trækhåndtag i sidestyringen.
Pilene er bevaret til præcis flytning, og den nye rækkefølge gemmes centralt for alle dashboardklienter.
Nyt centralt sidebibliotek gør det muligt at oprette, omdøbe, flytte og fjerne sider direkte fra navigationen.
Egne tomme sider får automatisk det fælles kortgalleri, redigering, resize og scrolling.
Fjernede standardsider bevares som skabeloner og kan altid oprettes igen med deres oprindelige funktioner.
Kameragruppering understøtter nu flere almindelige kvalitetsnavne, herunder resolution channel, high/medium/low og HD/SD/main/sub streams.
Kameraentities med høj, mellem og lav opløsning samles nu automatisk under ét fysisk kameranavn.
Tre-prik-menuen på kameraet vælger og gemmer startkvaliteten uden kvalitetsnavne i kameratitlen.
Kameraskabeloner viser kun ét valg pr. fysisk kamera og får samme kvalitetsmenu direkte i kortet.
Skabelongalleriet indeholder nu genbrugelige kopier af de indbyggede kortdesigns fra alle dashboardets views.
Nye kort oprettes nu fra et fælles touchvenligt skabelongalleri med søgning og kategorier fra hele dashboardet.
Skabeloner kopieres som selvstændige kort og kan redigeres med navn, ikon, entity, bredde og højde.
Robot- og printer-specialkort vises kun på sider, der understøtter deres fulde funktioner.
Kamerakort bruger korrekt billedformat, kan fylde op til seks rækker og resize-håndtaget kan scrolles fri af redigeringsmenuen.
Kamera-watchdoggen genindlæser ikke længere hele dashboardet efter gentagne streamfejl.
Recovery genstarter nu kun kamerarammer og HA-forbindelsen, så aktivt view, scroll og touch-arbejde bevares.
Flyttet layoutknapperne på Sikkerhed, Pool og Bil uden for skjulbare sektioner, så layout altid kan åbnes og gendannes.
Kameraer har nu layoutstyring til featured kamera og kameragrid.
Valgt kamera, lyd, bevægelsesstatus og streamlogik er bevaret.
Vejr har nu layoutstyring til aktuelt vejr, timeudsigt, ugeudsigt og radar.
Radarens iframe forbliver monteret ved almindelige vejr-opdateringer.
Musik har nu en layoutdialog til afspiller/højttalere og bibliotek/søgning/album.
Music Assistant-afspilning, grupper og volumen er bevaret.
Kalender har nu en layoutdialog til affald/afhentning og kommende kalenderaftaler.
Eksisterende kalendere og affaldssensorer er bevaret.
Views med egne kort bliver nu automatisk lodret scrollbare, når indholdet er højere end skærmen.
Kamerakort på blandt andet Sikkerhed beskæres ikke længere ved store kortstørrelser.
Bil har nu en layoutdialog til batteri/rækkevidde og status, opladning samt dæktryk.
Tesla-data og låsestyring er bevaret.
Pool har nu en layoutdialog til status/styring, livekamera samt temperatur- og driftsindsigt.
Pumpe, automatik, kamera og temperaturhistorik er bevaret.
Varme har nu en layoutdialog til komfortzoner, varmepumper, Dantherm og fjernvarme.
Eksisterende temperatur- og varmepumpestyring er bevaret.
Energi har nu en layoutdialog til anbefaling, nøgletal, strømprisgraf, forbrugsgraf og forbrug pr. enhed.
Eksisterende grafer og Overblik/Nu-funktion er bevaret.
Sikkerhed har nu en touch-venlig layoutdialog til at vise eller skjule status, alarmsystemer og indgange.
Alarm-, låse- og dør/vinduesstyring er uændret.
Rumkort kan nu redigeres direkte: skjul rum og ændr rækkefølgen med touch-venlige op/ned-knapper.
Rum-popup, lysstyring, termostater og live-status er uændret.
Rettet Rum-viewet efter en syntaksfejl i den nye kortstørrelsesberegning, som forhindrede hele Rum-scriptet i at indlæse.
Fase 2 Sikkerhed-migrering startet: hero, alarmsystemer og indgange kan nu styres via fælles layoutindstillinger uden at ændre alarm- eller låsestyringen.
Fase 2 Rum-migrering startet: rumkort læser nu fælles layoutdata for rækkefølge, skjulte rum og kortstørrelse, mens popup- og live-styring forbliver uændret.
Tilføjet fælles specialkort-kontrakt til fase 2-migreringen, så eksisterende widgets kan få layout, størrelse, synlighed og settings uden at miste deres side-specifikke renderer.
Fase 3-kortbiblioteket udvidet med Graf, Kamera, Medieafspiller og Kalender.
De nye kort bruger samme entity-søgning, layout, redigering og live-opdatering som de eksisterende kort.
Brugerdefinerede kortnavne bruges nu også direkte i statistik- og touch-kort i stedet for kun at stå som separat label.
Tilføjet Vis/skjul-kort til egne entity-kort, så kort kan deaktiveres uden at blive slettet.
Skjulte kort bevarer entity, navn, ikon, type og layout og kan aktiveres igen fra indstillinger.
Editorbaren er gjort touch- og kioskvenlig med vandret scroll, faste 48 px touchmål og responsiv placering.
Editorbaren kan ikke længere skubbe eller ændre højden på det aktive view.
Tilføjet eksport og import af den aktive sides egne kort som JSON.
Importerede kort får nye id'er, så de ikke kolliderer med eksisterende kort eller overskriver dem utilsigtet.
Tilføjet Ryd egne kort i editoren med bekræftelse; faste specialkort og sidens originale indhold påvirkes ikke.
Rydning kan fortrydes i samme redigeringssession før layoutet gemmes.
Brugerdefinerede kort kan nu få eget ikon ud over kortnavn, korttype og entity.
Ikonet bruges i statistik- og entity-visningen og gemmes sammen med kortets layout.
Rettet touch-interaktion i editoren, så Dupliker kort er klikbar sammen med indstillinger, fjern, flyt og skaler.
Editorens klikblokering tillader nu alle aktive redigerings-handles uden at gøre kortindhold utilsigtet interaktivt.
Tilføjet Dupliker kort i editoren, så ens kort kan bygges hurtigt videre med samme størrelse og layout.
Duplikerede kort får et nyt id og kan ændres separat uden at påvirke originalen.
Tilføjet central validering og migreringsgrundlag for alle side-layouts, så ugyldige eller gamle kortdata ikke kan ødelægge et helt view.
Kortdata normaliseres med sikre standarder for id, type, entity og navn før siderne monteres.
Rettet højde-regression i side-editoren: det ekstra custom-kort-grid kan ikke længere arve fuld højde eller dele eksisterende views i to.
Tilføjet permanent CSS-regressionsværn mod 100%-højde på editorens hjælpe-grid.
Eksisterende brugerdefinerede kort kan nu skifte mellem Entity/sensor, Statistik og Touch-knap direkte fra kortets indstillinger.
Korttype, kortnavn og entity gemmes samlet, så kort kan bygges videre på uden at blive slettet og oprettet igen.
Udvidet kortbiblioteket med Statistik og touch-venlig Touch-knap til switch, låse og covers.
Touch-kort bruger Home Assistant-servicekald og opdaterer sig sammen med den valgte entity.
Fælles kort-editor har nu Fortryd, Nulstil og tydeligere gem-flow, så layoutændringer kan afprøves sikkert før de gemmes.
Ændringer i kort, entity-valg og kortnavne gemmes som redigeringshistorik under den aktive session.
Rettet entity-kort så de bliver vist efter de er gemt, ikke kun mens redigering er åben.
Tilføjet redigering af kortnavn og valgt entity på de nye kort.
Rettet editoren så et view ikke automatisk får oprettet kort, når redigering åbnes; kort tilføjes nu kun efter brugerens valg.
Rettet fuldhøjde-fejlen hvor et tomt editor-grid skubbede eksisterende view-indhold ned. Editor-området er nu skjult uden for redigering og fylder kun plads under aktiv redigering.
Tilføjet fælles redigering til de øvrige views: vælg, flyt, skaler og fjern entity-kort direkte på siden.
Entity-kort viser først relevante forslag for det aktuelle område, men kan altid søge i alle Home Assistant-entiteter til special- og custom-sensorer.
Editoren genkobler automatisk efter live-opdateringer, så et view ikke mister sine redigeringsmuligheder når data genindlæses.

Moved the front-page three-dot menu away from the camera card and into the exact same fixed position as the Robotter and 3D Printer menus: at the far-right edge, 8 px below the green live connection dot. Camera selection, front-page editing and screensaver actions are unchanged.

Matched the front-page three-dot camera menu button to the new Robotter and 3D Printer edit buttons: no visible border, background or shadow, with the existing camera menu behavior and positioning left unchanged and a full 44 x 44 px touch target retained.

The Robotter page editor can now add a Robot card and choose any Home Assistant vacuum or lawn_mower entity directly. Smartdash builds the card from that robot's own device entities, including available status, battery, image/map, controls, selectors and quick actions; known configured robots retain their tailored card.
An existing robot card can now switch to a different robot directly from its card settings while edit mode is active.
Removed the visible border, background and shadow from the three-dot edit buttons on Robotter and 3D Printer while preserving their full 44 x 44 px touch targets.

Replaced the large 'Rediger siden' buttons on Robotter and 3D Printer with compact three-dot menu buttons positioned at the extreme right edge directly below the green live connection indicator. The touch target remains 44 x 44 px.

Fixed the new Robotter and 3D Printer card layouts using only part of the available page height. The editor's invisible insertion marker was accidentally counted as an additional grid row; it is now excluded from layout so height-2 cards correctly fill the full view from top to bottom.

Robotter can now be edited directly on the page with the same live card editor as the front page: move, resize, add and remove cards, and choose whether each robot card shows full controls, compact status, media only or controls only.
3D Printer now has the same direct page editor, with independently resizable camera and control cards plus live-camera and status-camera selection directly from the camera card settings.
Fixed the built-in Leonora and Poul product images appearing as large black fields in the light theme by adding dedicated premium light-theme variants while preserving the original dark-theme images.
The shared card editor now supports per-card settings without leaving edit mode, and printer state updates keep the existing live-camera player mounted to avoid reconnect flicker.
Clarified the screen-lock setup: the PIN is stored centrally in the server configuration and applies to every dashboard screen.

Internal groundwork for bringing live card editing to more tabs -- adds a shared library of reusable card types (a simple stat tile and a pick-any-entity card) that any tab's editor can offer, on top of last update's shared engine. No visible change on its own yet.

Internal refactor of the front page's live card editor -- no visible change on its own, but it's now built as a shared engine so the same drag/resize/add/remove card editing can be brought to other tabs going forward.

The camera menu now sits directly beside the camera card (right against its edge) when there's room, instead of always defaulting to the corner of the page -- it measures the card's actual position rather than assuming one, so it adapts correctly whether the front page uses the classic layout, the freeform card builder, or a narrow/portrait screen. Falls back to the card's own inside corner only when it's flush against the edge of the screen with nowhere else to go.

The camera menu (formerly on top of, then beside, the live picture) is now a standalone floating button in the top-right corner of the front page -- completely detached from the camera card, so the picture always fills the card's full width and height. Stays in the same corner regardless of where the camera card is placed or resized.

Fixed the PIN screen staying hardcoded dark everywhere it's used -- entering/setting/changing/removing a PIN from Administration is a normal in-context prompt and now follows the light/dark theme like every other admin dialog, with correctly adapted button and text colors in both. Only the actual "screen is now locked" ambient lock (triggered by idle or a manual lock) stays deliberately always-dark, matching the screensaver's own look.
Fixed alert photos looking stretched when a banner was dragged wider -- the photo now keeps its original proportions and just gets bigger, instead of only widening while its height stayed fixed.

Fixed the camera menu column overlapping the live picture instead of sitting beside it -- an insetting bug meant the reserved space was being subtracted twice, leaving the picture and the menu overlapping rather than separated. The menu column also now has its own visible background so it reads as a clearly separate area from the picture.
The camera menu (the ⋮ button on the front page's camera card) no longer floats on top of the live picture -- it now sits in its own narrow column to the right of it, so nothing is covered.
The camera menu button now follows the light/dark theme (dark in light mode, light in dark mode) instead of always being white.
Post and 3D-printer alerts now always show their full-size photo, even in the combined alert layout -- previously shrunk to a small thumbnail there, which defeated the point of a photo alert.
Alert boxes (separate or combined) can now be dragged wider from a handle in the bottom-right corner, for anyone who wants to see more detail -- never smaller than today's default size.

Fixed the HA Smartdash logo/branding text (admin sidebar, About card, and the first-login screen) being unreadable in light mode -- it's part of an image file with hardcoded near-white text, which is now built inline so the text can follow the theme like everything else. The icon mark itself keeps its own fixed colors.

Moved the two "what shows in the clock card" toggles (Naeste aftaler / Affald) from the Kalender & affald panel into Administration -> Forside, next to the new car/pool/robot/printer tile settings -- everything that controls what appears on the front page now lives in one place, separate from picking the underlying calendars/sensors.

Fixed the doors/windows/locks alert schedule not reliably appearing or disappearing exactly at its start/end time -- banners were previously only re-checked when a door/lock actually changed state, so a schedule boundary (or an expired 30-minute snooze) could sit stale until something unrelated happened to trigger a refresh. Now re-checked every 30 seconds on its own.
Post and 3D-printer alerts now always show their photo as a small thumbnail when the combined alert layout is used, instead of falling back to a plain icon.

The two small tiles under the clock's calendar (previously always Bil/Pool) can now each be set to show car, pool, robots or 3D-printer status, or be turned off entirely -- Administration -> Forside -> Ur-widgets.

The "Naeste aftaler" and "Affald" sections under the clock can each be turned off individually (Administration -> Kalender & affald) for households that don't use one of them -- when only one is on, it takes over the space the other would have used instead of leaving a gap.

The calendar list under the clock now respects the calendar selection already set under Administration -> Kalender & affald, instead of always showing every calendar entity found -- leave the selection empty to keep showing all of them.
Alerts (post/printer/doors) can now be shown either as separate floating cards (as before) or stacked together in one shared card -- choose under Administration -> Advarsler -> Visning.

The front page finally gets a real, live edit mode: tap "Rediger forsiden" to drag cards to reorder them, resize them, add new cards (any of the existing card types, or any HA entity), and remove cards -- directly on the dashboard itself, with an explicit Gem/Annuller step so nothing saves by accident on a shared touchscreen. The old preset-picker editor (which no longer matched the current layout system) is gone.
The front page's per-card rendering was refactored into a single shared function used by both the initial page load and the new live editor, so they can never drift out of sync with each other.

Fixed the Home Assistant address field (shown once, before first login) being nearly unreadable in light mode -- its background was hardcoded dark while the text followed the theme, giving dark text on a near-black box.

The 3D printer panel's live camera can now be picked directly from your camera entities (Administration -> Opsætning -> 3D Printer -> Livekamera), instead of only accepting a hand-typed go2rtc stream name. Useful for a printer camera that isn't wired into go2rtc under a specific stream name.

Simplified the doors/windows/locks alert time window (Administration -> Advarsler) to one on/off switch with the two time fields appearing only once it's turned on, instead of a separate on/off dropdown for doors and another for locks with the time fields always visible whether or not the schedule was actually active. That made it easy to fill in a start/end time and assume it was working, when the schedule itself was still off and the alert kept showing all day.
Fixed the admin sidebar staying hardcoded dark regardless of the light/dark theme setting -- it now follows the theme like the rest of the admin panel.

Fixed several accent colors (used for icons, borders and highlights across the whole dashboard and admin) being tuned only for a dark background -- in light mode they showed up as pale, washed-out or oddly bright instead of a real color. Aurora, Ocean and Ember now get proper darker, higher-contrast versions of their accent colors in light mode.

"Auto" theme mode now switches between light and dark based on time of day (light 07:00-20:00, dark otherwise) instead of following the browser's static dark-mode preference -- on a kiosk that preference doesn't change through the day, so "Auto" could end up looking permanently stuck on one mode instead of actually switching.

The post/3D-printer/doors banners now default to off instead of on. A config saved before these existed was silently getting them turned on after updating (since missing settings fall back to their default), which could cover an existing custom front-page layout without ever being asked for.

Administration -> Opdatering now shows a note (with a way to clear it) if idle auto-install is currently paused for a specific version -- previously invisible, making a paused state impossible to diagnose from the admin panel.

Fixed the PIN lock screen being nearly unreadable in light mode -- its text/keypad colors were following the light theme while its card background stayed hardcoded dark, causing dark-on-dark text. The whole lock screen is now consistently dark regardless of theme (matching the screensaver's own always-dark design), instead of a broken mix of the two.

Fixed Administration being stuck with a dark page background regardless of the light/dark theme setting, while individual cards tried to follow the theme -- producing a patchy, half-switched look. Also fixed several smaller admin surfaces (form fields, list rows, warning banners) that were hardcoded dark and didn't adapt to light mode.

Screensaver camera tiles are bigger again, with a guaranteed, visible gap between them and a smaller (but still consistent) margin to the screen edge -- the previous auto-distributed spacing could collapse to zero once the tiles got big enough to need shrinking to fit.

Fixed the camera row not being vertically centered in the space between the weather/security pills and the bottom hint text -- it was hugging the hint text instead, because the reserved space wasn't actually being reserved.
Fixed the camera row's side margin effectively doubling up with the screen's own edge margin.
The vertical spacing in the screensaver's bottom section (camera row to hint text) now matches the spacing used between the weather/security pills above it, for a more consistent rhythm.

Fixed the screensaver preview in Administration not accurately reflecting the real layout/sizing -- several measurements (padding, clock size, camera spacing) were using viewport-relative units that resolved against the actual browser window instead of the preview's own fixed canvas.

The dashboard now checks for a new release every 10 minutes instead of every 12 hours, so it actually picks up a new version automatically (while idle) soon after one ships, instead of running a stale build until someone manually reloads it.
Added a "Start pauseskærm" button to the camera menu (the ⋮ button on the front page's camera card) so you can preview the screensaver on demand instead of waiting for it to trigger on its own.

Fixed screensaver/front-page camera tiles showing an empty box with no picture -- the live camera feed wasn't forcing the same reliable video transport already used by the camera strip on the front page, so it could silently fail to connect.

Camera tiles that fall back to a still image (cameras without a fast live-stream source) now retry periodically if the first snapshot fails to load, instead of staying blank for the rest of the idle period.
Added two more cameras (3D-printer, Bag indgang) to the fast live-stream path instead of falling back to a still image.
Cleaned up the Pauseskærm -> Design row: background image/upload, color, and clock size now share one consistent control height instead of a mix of default browser sizes.

The save button now sits in its own clearly-marked bar between the editable settings and the preview, instead of being buried at the bottom of just the Design card -- it saves the whole page (schedule, design and brightness together).

Fixed the real cause of waking up on the wrong page: the tap that dismissed the screensaver could also register as a real click on whatever card/button happened to be underneath it (e.g. the Energy card), instantly navigating there right after returning to Overview.
The screensaver's camera picker (Administration -> Pauseskærm) is now a checkbox grid instead of a multi-select list -- easier to see and pick up to 3 cameras.
Waking the screen from the screensaver now always returns to Overview, instead of sometimes staying on whatever page was open before the kiosk went idle.

Fixed cameras picked for the screensaver (or the front-page preview) not showing at all if they weren't also in the separate camera allowlist under Administration -> Kameraer -> Kamera-entities -- the screensaver's own camera picker is now independent of that list.

The front-page visual preview's cards now show real, styled content instead of plain text: a colored icon + big number for weather/energy/security (green when secured, amber when not), and a real-size ticking clock -- much closer to what each card actually looks like on the real front page.

The front-page visual preview (Administration -> Forside) now shows a real live camera feed for the camera card instead of a static snapshot, and the clock card actually ticks -- matching the same live fidelity as the screensaver preview.

Added a real, to-scale visual preview to the front-page builder (Administration -> Forside), alongside the existing labeled-box layout preview -- shows actual card styling/icons, and real data where available (weather, security, a live camera snapshot, a custom card's entity state).
Moved the front-page card builder (content, size, order, live preview) out of Grundindstillinger into its own "Forside" section in Administration.

The screensaver's "tap to open dashboard" hint (and camera tiles, if any) now always sit at the bottom of the screen, and the clock/date/summary now always stays centered in the middle -- previously, turning cameras on pushed the clock off-center towards the top.
Screensaver camera tiles are a bit bigger.

Reworked the screensaver's camera option: instead of a full-screen live background, up to 3 cameras now show as small tiles in a row at the bottom (1 camera is centered, 2-3 sit side by side) -- the clock/date/weather/security summary keeps its original centered design either way.
With no camera selected, the screensaver's clock and summary are centered on the screen exactly as before this feature was added.
Active alert banners (post, 3D printer, doors/locks) now also show as small badges on the screensaver, since the rest of the dashboard is hidden while it's up.

The screensaver (the ambient screen shown when the kiosk is idle) is now customizable from Administration -> Pauseskærm: a background image or color, a clock size option, and an optional camera shown as a full-screen live background. An optional brightness slider controls the kiosk's own screen light entity.

The Pauseskærm preview now shows a real, live, to-scale replica of the actual screensaver (same look, same data) instead of a simplified summary, so background/clock/camera changes can be checked before saving.
Reverted the previous release's separate PIN lock-screen design settings -- that functionality has moved to the screensaver above instead, where it was actually meant to be.

The lock screen (shown when the screen is PIN-locked) is now customizable from a new Administration -> Låseskærm section: a background image or color, an on-screen clock (with a size option), and an optional camera shown as a full-screen live background behind the code pad.

Optional brightness slider on the lock screen -- turn it on in Låseskærm and it controls this kiosk's own screen light entity (the same one already used to turn the screen on/off, set up under Grundindstillinger -> Kiosk & dørklokke).

Alert banner positions (post, 3D printer, doors/locks) are now remembered centrally instead of per-browser -- dragging a banner to a spot now sticks no matter which browser or device the dashboard is opened on, instead of resetting the moment it's opened somewhere new. Existing per-browser positions are carried over automatically the first time this version loads.

Fixed a layout bug where overview cards could shift out of place or leave large unused gaps -- caused by an internal banner-system element that was unintentionally being treated as part of the grid layout.

The updater no longer silently reinstalls a version you just rolled back from during its idle auto-update check -- rolling back (via Administration or a manual restore) now sticks until a genuinely newer release comes along. The manual "Update now" button is unaffected.

The doors/windows and locks alert can now each be restricted to a configurable time window (e.g. only warn overnight, between 22:00 and 06:00) -- set independently in Administration -> Advarsler, since a door left open at night and one left open during the day are usually different concerns.

Fixed a bug where saving settings that write more than one field at once (e.g. Advarsler, or the dashboard title/favicon) could report "couldn't save" even though the save actually went through -- these now write in a single request instead of several racing ones.

Banners now stack flush against each other (12px gap, based on each one's real measured height) instead of fixed-size slots sized for the tallest banner -- a shorter banner no longer leaves a gap above the one below it.

Redesigned the doors/windows/locks banner as a compact single-row card (small icon + status line) instead of the full picture-card layout -- it's a status line, not a picture, so it no longer takes up as much space as the post/printer banners.

The 3D printer banner's camera picker no longer replaces the printer's built-in camera -- both are shown, with the picked camera as the primary image and a switcher in the detail popup to flip between it and the printer's own camera, the same way the post banner already switches between its camera angles.

Added an optional camera picker to the 3D printer banner (in Administration -> Advarsler): pick any camera entity to use instead of the printer's own built-in camera image -- useful if a separate camera (e.g. a security camera) is pointed at the printer instead of relying on its own onboard one.
Generalized the post banner into a multi-banner system: multiple alert banners can now be visible at the same time, each independently draggable and remembering its own position.

New 3D printer banner: shows the printer's camera image and progress while it's printing or paused. Reuses the entities already configured for the 3D Printer page -- no extra setup needed if that's already set up.

New doors & locks banner: warns if a door or lock has been open/unlocked longer than a configurable number of minutes (15 by default), instead of nagging the moment it opens. Reuses the entities already configured under Security.
All three banners (post, 3D printer, doors & locks) can be turned on/off independently from the Advarsler section in Administration, which also now has the doors/locks time threshold.

Fixed grainy/choppy camera video on the overview page: it ran up to three simultaneous full 4K (16 Mbps) live streams at once for the small thumbnail strip, which is more than a kiosk device can decode smoothly. Switched to go2rtc's lower-resolution substream for these thumbnails specifically -- plenty sharp at thumbnail size, and far lighter to decode. The dedicated Cameras page (which only ever streams one camera live at a time) is unaffected and still uses full quality.

Added a dedicated "Advarsler" (Alerts) section in Administration: the post banner's on/off switch and all six of its entity fields (presence, count, description, three camera pictures) now live together in one place, instead of being split between Kioskfunktioner and Setup -> Kiosk & dørklokke.

Fixed the post banner jumping sideways the instant you touched its drag handle: it used position: absolute, which measures its own drag coordinates against the overview grid's box -- offset from the actual screen edge by the nav rail's width -- so the moment a position was applied, it landed shifted by exactly that offset. Switched to position: fixed (viewport-relative), matching how the floating music player already positions itself correctly.

Fixed the banner's position sometimes reverting/drifting on reload: its entrance fade-in animation also animated position (translate), and with no explicit end state, the browser kept that animated value permanently applied afterward -- silently overriding any dragged position. The animation now only fades opacity.

The post banner is now post-only: it no longer competes with (or gets replaced by) open-door, unlocked-door, alarm, price, or power notifications -- that status is already visible on the Security and Energy cards, so mixing it into this banner just meant it sometimes wasn't about the mailbox at all.
Redesigned as a compact card: a drag handle at the top, a bigger picture below it, and shorter, tighter text underneath -- narrower overall than before.
The banner can now be dragged anywhere on screen by its handle, and remembers where you left it.

The detail popup now has a "Posten er hentet" button that clears the mailbox status directly from the dashboard, and the snooze button now matches the rest of the app's button styling instead of being a plain unstyled one.

Fixed the post banner never actually appearing: its container element was never added to the overview page's markup, so the code that shows it had nothing to attach to and silently did nothing every time -- not a new issue from v0.5.18, this container was missing from the start. It now actually shows up when there's post.

The post banner now shows a picture of the mailbox instead of just a bell icon, when a picture entity is configured under Setup -> Kiosk & dørklokke. Clicking it opens a bigger view with the full picture and the mail description, plus buttons to switch between multiple camera angles if more than one is configured.
Added a "Post-banner med billede" toggle under Indstillinger -> Kioskfunktioner to turn the whole thing off regardless of entity setup.
Added two more optional picture entity fields (in addition to the existing one) so up to three camera angles around the mailbox can be configured and switched between.

The Rooms grid no longer leaves a mostly-empty trailing row when the room count doesn't divide evenly into a full row (e.g. 15 rooms as 7, 7, 1). It now picks a column count that divides the actual number of rooms as evenly as possible -- the same 15 rooms now lay out as 5, 5, 5, with every card the same size and no wasted space, and it recalculates automatically if the window is resized or the room count changes.

Fixed the camera card sometimes only filling about half its container instead of the full card: its height came from a percentage (height: 100%) nested inside a flex chain, which can fail to resolve to a definite value on some browser engines and silently collapse. It's now anchored directly to the card's own box instead, which doesn't depend on that chain resolving correctly. Verified the camera menu button stays on top and clickable, and all camera tiles stay evenly sized.

Fixed the overview cutting off roughly a third of the way down in the dynamic card layout mode: a hidden placeholder element for the floating music player is a permanent last child of the overview grid, and while empty (no music playing) it was still being placed into its own grid row, pushing the real cards into the remaining space and leaving the rest blank. The placeholder no longer takes up a grid row while empty; the floating player itself is unaffected once music is actually playing.

The automatic update check now runs every 12 hours instead of every 30 minutes -- a new release isn't time-sensitive enough to justify checking more often, and this leaves an even wider safety margin under GitHub's hourly request limit.

Fixed a likely cause of persistent update-check failures: the dashboard checked GitHub for a new release every 60 seconds, a leftover interval from when this was a same-server comparison. Against a real GitHub API call, that alone is enough to exhaust GitHub's 60-requests-per-hour limit for unauthenticated requests from a single always-on kiosk -- shared by every kiosk and every open Administration tab on the same network. The check now runs every 30 minutes instead, and the server also caches GitHub's answer for a few minutes so multiple kiosks/tabs checking around the same time only cost one real request.

Administration -> Update now has an "Install a specific version from GitHub" field: paste a release link or just a version number (e.g. v0.5.9) to install that exact version directly, without waiting on or depending on the automatic check -- useful if auto-update isn't working, or you specifically want an older or newer version.

The v0.5.11 version-tag fix didn't actually show up for anyone with the dashboard already open: static files (admin.js, admin.css, and several other scripts/stylesheets) are served with a cache-busting version number in the URL, and it hadn't been bumped, so browsers kept using their already-cached old copies. All files touched in the last few releases now have a fresh cache-busting number.
The current-version card in Administration now reads "HA Smartdash v0.5.12" (matching the exact GitHub release title) instead of just the bare tag.

The version number shown in Administration -> Update (both the current version and version history) now matches the release tag on GitHub (e.g. "v0.5.11") instead of the internal date-based build ID -- easier to tell which release you're actually looking at, and to compare notes with someone else's install.

The four waste-pickup tiles on the Waste page now stack in a single column instead of spreading across the available width -- easier to scan at a glance instead of splitting attention across a 2-wide grid.

Fixed the robot vacuum's cleaning-map card blinking on the Robots page: the whole panel re-renders whenever any of its entities change, which is frequent while it's actively cleaning (progress, current room) -- each re-render was destroying and recreating the map image from scratch and re-fetching it, leaving it blank for a moment every single time. The last loaded map now carries over between re-renders instead of going blank, and the map itself only actually re-fetches a few times a minute instead of on every update.

Fixed the favicon preview in Setup showing a broken-image icon instead of the current favicon: it used a relative path (./favicon.svg), which resolves against the admin page's own URL (/admin/) instead of the site root, so the browser requested a file that doesn't exist there and got the app's fallback page back instead of an image. It now uses an absolute path so the preview always shows what's actually in use.

The new Screensaver section in Administration now actually switches to English when English is selected -- it shipped Danish-only in the previous version. All its labels, options, and the live preview's weather/security summary now follow the language picker.

Fixed remaining overview clipping on portrait/mobile screens and on short desktop cards: wide cards (weather especially) could collapse to zero height because a card and its own content were both sized off each other with no real anchor, cutting content off instead of showing it. Cards now get real minimum heights per breakpoint, and the page scrolls instead of clipping when content still doesn't fit.
The Security card's door/lock rows, and the clock card's compact car/planner rows, now shrink their own spacing and font sizes when the card itself is short, instead of overflowing it.

The screensaver now has its own dedicated section in Administration, instead of being buried inside "Appearance & this device": schedule it, set the time window it's allowed to show in, set how many minutes until the screen turns fully off, or turn it off entirely so it's never active on that kiosk.

Fixed the screensaver never showing weather: it read window.BeastHaSocket/window.BeastConfig, which are never actually set (those modules only exist as local script-scope variables) -- so the check silently always failed and the weather line stayed empty regardless of whether a weather entity was configured. It now reads the correct references.
The new screensaver section includes a live preview using your real weather and security data, so you can confirm it actually shows what you expect without waiting for the screen to go idle.

Camera discovery no longer requires a specific NVR sub-stream naming convention ("_medium_resolution_channel") and a hand-curated go2rtc stream-name mapping just to appear at all -- any HA camera entity can now be selected on the front page, in the camera picker, and on the full Cameras page.

Cameras without a go2rtc mapping now show a live snapshot via Home Assistant's own camera image instead of not showing up at all -- refreshed on the same interval as go2rtc thumbnails, though without go2rtc's lower-latency stream.

The dashboard's update check now talks to GitHub Releases directly, the same way Administration's Update panel already did, instead of comparing the live page against this server's own beast.html. The old same-server comparison could only ever detect a change already hand-pushed to that specific server, which is meaningless for an install that's never received one -- and could misfire on its own during active development, which is what caused the update banner to seem to reappear on its own.

"Opdater nu" on the dashboard now actually downloads and installs the release from GitHub before reloading, instead of just reloading the browser (which only worked if something had already been placed on disk by other means).

Fixed the update-available banner appearing to pop up fresh every time a modal (like the camera picker) was closed: it was the same pending banner the whole time, just hidden behind the modal's higher stacking order and revealed the instant the modal closed. It now stays visibly on top of regular modals instead of flickering in and out.

Fixed the real cause of overlapping content on the overview: tablet/portrait height controls were mistakenly removed from the overview builder earlier today after an incomplete check missed that they're actually used (grid-row: span var(--tablet-h)) -- every card was silently forced to a single, often too-short row on tablet and portrait, which is what made entries overlap and other cards clip content. The height fields are back, and default cards (clock, security, weather, energy) now get enough room to fit what they actually contain instead of just one row-unit.
Fixed door/lock rows in the Security overview card overlapping each other on narrow cards (e.g. tablet width): the status badge column had no overflow protection and could spill over the door name

Fixed the overview grid using the wrong breakpoint: it measured the browser's full viewport width, not the space actually left after the nav rail and padding, so cards stayed cramped in 12-column desktop mode at viewport widths (roughly 1180-1450px) where less than 1180px was really available. Now measured against the real available width via a container query.

The default overview layout (installs that haven't customized cards yet) no longer collapses every card to the same width on tablet -- wide cards (weather, energy) now span two tablet columns like the camera card already did, instead of shrinking to the same width as compact cards (clock, security)
The weather card's internal layout now stacks instead of overflowing when the card itself is narrow
The mail/post notification banner no longer has a fixed minimum width wider than very narrow screens

The update system in Administration now actually contacts GitHub Releases instead of only checking versions already present on this specific server. Installs that have never received a hand-pushed update (a fresh clone, for example) can now discover and install new releases directly.

"Install new version" downloads, validates, and installs the release automatically when it isn't already available locally, falling back to the fast local copy when it is -- your config and local settings are never touched.

New api/update.php endpoint: checks the latest GitHub release, downloads its source archive, verifies it, snapshots the current install first, and rolls back automatically if the install fails partway through.

Fixed the overview builder showing a layout that didn't match the actual dashboard on installs that hadn't customized the overview yet: the default cards were assembled in an order that didn't reconstruct the real fixed layout once run through the grid's placement rules
The overview builder no longer shows an empty card list on a fresh install with no saved configuration

The overview builder's live preview now uses the exact same grid rules as the real dashboard (dense packing, height capped at 2 rows), so it actually matches what you'll see on the overview instead of a rough approximation
Removed the tablet-height and portrait-height size fields from the overview builder: they never had any effect on the dashboard, so they were misleading
Fixed the desktop height dropdown offering values up to 6 when only 1-2 have any effect
Fixed size legends overlapping each other in the overview builder
The "+ Add card" button in the overview builder is now styled instead of a plain unstyled browser button
Fixed cramped width/height dropdowns in the overview builder on wide screens: each card's size fields now respond to the card's own width, not the browser window's
Fixed the visual overview builder: changing a card's content type no longer silently fails to show its entity picker
The overview builder now shows a live preview grid that updates instantly as you edit cards
Cards in the overview builder can now be reordered by dragging them, not just with the up/down buttons
Simplified version history: only the single latest version gets a prominent "Install new version" card, everything else moved into a dropdown to restore an older version from
The very latest available version now says "Install new version" in version history instead of "Update to this version"
Installing/updating/restoring a version now shows a real progress bar and a clear success message before reloading
Administration stays on the Update tab after that reload, instead of jumping back to Overview
Version history now clearly distinguishes newer versions ("New" badge, "Update to this version") from older ones ("Restore this version")
Fixed the "current" label in version history staying in Danish regardless of the language setting
Administration → Update now shows a live status pill: checking, up to date, or update available, with a manual "Check for updates" button
Restoring a previous version now shows an inline success/error message instead of a native browser alert
The current-version tile in Administration → Update is now readable (date + build number instead of one long digit string)
Release notes and the changelog shown in Administration are now written in English
The language picker in Administration now also translates the entire admin panel, not just the dashboard
New section in Administration under Update: view version history and restore a previous version with one click
Admin buttons (backup, security, update, etc.) now have a real design instead of plain grey boxes
New language picker at the top of Administration next to the Home Assistant status: the dashboard can be shown in English (default) or Danish
Fixed a bug where switching language didn't actually take effect, because the language setting wasn't read correctly
The camera panel on the overview now fills its space correctly, regardless of screen size or camera count
Fixed a crash in the Security panel when no alarm panel was configured
Fixed hidden pages selected in Administration not actually being hidden on the dashboard
Fixed overview card scaling so text and numbers always fit the card's own size, not the screen's
Fixed locks and door sensors sometimes being paired incorrectly in the Security widget on the overview
The screen-lock PIN is now shared across all browsers/devices instead of only working where it was created
Robot vacuum and robot mower images can now be chosen freely under Robots in Administration
